relationships.subject: IL-24
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicate that IL-24 modulates T-currents by targeting the IL-22R1 receptor.

relationships.subject: Lyn
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings demonstrate that Lyn activation is necessary for the IL-24/IL-22R1-induced response in T-type channel activity.

relationships.subject: PKA
relationships.evidence_quote: These results demonstrated that IL-24 stimulated T-type channels through PKA, but independent of cAMP.

relationships.subject: Cav3.2
relationships.evidence_quote: The IL-24-induced increase in the AP firing rate was completely abolished when the expression of Cav3.2 was knockdown using Cav3.2-siRNA

key_findings: IL-24 enhances T-type currents in trigeminal neurons via IL-22R1 coupled to Lyn-dependent, cAMP-independent PKA signaling, independent of JAK1, p38, or PKC.
Blocking IL-22R1 or T-type channels or knocking down Cav3.2 relieves IL-24-induced and CCI-ION mechanical allodynia.
